  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Quick Start}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}

library(monopolyAtlas)
set.seed(42); m <- matrix(runif(1000*50), nrow=1000)
rownames(m) <- paste0("Gene", 1:1000)
colnames(m) <- paste0("Sample", 1:50)
result <- score_monopoly(m, k_top=5)
print(result); plot(result)
data("monopoly_atlas"); query_gene("EEF1A1"); plot_gene("EEF1A1")
